messages:
li: Heads up — we're doing the runtime build cutover for the 'slim-binary + quant-v3b' bundle in ~2h. planning: staggered canary slices, prefix-KV probe, light smoke, then regional ramp.

sam: thx. what's the canary slice size?

li: slice 1 = 1% traffic (latency-sensitive), slice 2 = 5%, slice 3 = 20% (if green). we'll pause between slices for 10m perf windows.

maya: call out: quant-v3b has new matmul kernel + changed fp16->q4_0 path. ensure fallback to q8-compatible kernel if mismatch.

li: yes — runtime has kernel-compat fallback. but we need to pin older kernel on a small cohort as safety net. plan: pin 5% of staging to kernel-abi:v2024-11 for 6h.

eric: can you add the pin in deploybot? i want observability on token-level cost and tail-latency.

li: @deploybot please create pin: target=staging cohort-5pct, kernel=abi:v2024-11, ttl=6h, tag=pre-cutover-safety

deploybot: Received. Preparing pin request...

deploybot: Pin created: id=pin-ccf4, target=staging:cohort-5pct, kernel=abi:v2024-11, ttl=6h. To unpin early: `/deploybot unpin pin-ccf4`

maya: good. owners: who runs the prefix-KV probe and gathers cache-hit telemetry?

ops-bot: ops oncall assigned: eric. Will coordinate smoke runs and collect KV probe logs.

eric: i'll run a quick kv probe 30m before cutover and post results. will also verify pastebin with smoke commands.

sam: rollback criteria suggestion: auto rollback if 5xx rate >0.5% sustained over 3min OR p95 latency regression >30% vs baseline OR cache miss spike >3x. Agree?

maya: agree + fail on correctness diffs for placeholder eval set (prompt-suite v2). If any eval diffs >1% we halt.

li: adding to runbook. also note memory blowouts: if OOMs in any canary host, immediate rollforward block and escalate.

eric: smoke checklist (short):
- run `./scripts/kv_probe.sh --runs 50` -> paste logs
- smoke gen: `curl -X POST /v1/generate -d @sample.json` validate tokens and latencies
- run eval suite: `python -m evals.run prompt-suite-v2` and capture pass rate

li: release-notes blurb draft: "runtime: v3.2.0-quant-slim — new matmul kernel, quant-v3b path, optimized prefix KV caching. Staged rollout with kernel pin fallback. See runbook for rollback triggers."

sam: can we gate the public release notes until the 20% slice is green? prefer to not publish until no regressions in rolling windows.

li: agreed. internal release notes will go out post-1% slice health-check. public wait until 20% green and no pin escalations.

maya: one more: ensure the nightly autoscale policy is disabled for the 3h maintenance window to avoid noisy autoscale affecting latency signals.

ops-bot: autoscale policy paused for staging cluster: staging-autoscale -> paused by ops-bot until +4h.

li: final owners recap: li = release lead, eric = smoke/ops, maya = kernel/compat, sam = observability + rollback guard. I'll post runbook and the preflight checks in 30m.

sam: thanks — i'll set up dashboards: tail-latency, 5xx, cost-per-token delta, kv-hitrate trend.

deploybot: Preflight hook: running verification: build-checks, signature, checksum -> OK.

li: ok team — sync back in #eng-runtime 15m before cutover. :thumbsup:
